name: End of Day Review
description: Weekly review - surface items that fell through cracks

steps.label: Weekly review
steps.prompt:
Perform a weekly review:

1. Call mc_search_tasks with status=todo and no due date - surface any Scout-pushed items older than 5 days that haven't been touched. These may be stale or need re-evaluation.

2. Scan this week's business M365 sent emails - did I promise anything that isn't tracked in MC? If so, push those commitments.

3. Check next week's calendar - any meetings that need prep work? Push prep tasks with due dates set to day-before-meeting.

4. For any items that seem no longer relevant (old email threads that resolved themselves, cancelled meetings), mark them for potential cleanup but don't auto-delete - flag in description.
